description: Rep. Mary Margaret Oliver of Decatur, fellow Democratic state Rep. Phil Olaleye, and Republican state Reps. Martin Momtahan of Dallas and Derrick McCollum of Chestnut Mountain have filed legislation seeking to curb out-of-state hedge funds that have bought up real estate which, they say, deprives Georgia residents from pursuing homeownership.
